(Setup)
```{r}
set.seed(42)
library(tidyverse)
library(gt)
```

For loops
```{r}
for (i in seq_len(20)){
  print(i^3)
}
```

```{r}
for (i in seq_len(5)){
  word <- paste(sample(letters, 5, replace = TRUE), collapse="")
  print(word)
}
```

Example: 10-course breakfast
```{r}
breakfast <- c("eggs", "bacon", "sausages", "toast")
nums <- c(seq_len(5))
table <- tibble()

for (i in seq_len(10)){
  current_row <- tibble(
    Food = sample(breakfast, size=1),
    Number = sample(nums, size=1)
  )
  table <- tibble(table |> bind_rows(current_row))
}

gt(table)
```

Binomial distribution
```{r}
num_success <- 0

for (i in seq_len(1000)){
  is_pollinated <- sample(x = c("YES", "NO"), size = 200, replace = TRUE, prob = c(0.6, 0.4))
  num_pollinated <- sum(is_pollinated == "YES")
  
  if (num_pollinated >= 125){
    num_success <- num_success + 1
  }
}

print(num_success / 1000)
```

```{r}
n_sims <- 1000
n_flowers_per_sim <- 200

flowers <- rbinom(n = n_sims, size = n_flowers_per_sim, prob = 0.6
)
times_successful <- sum(flowers >= 125)

prop_successful <- times_successful / n_sims
print(prop_successful)
```


```{r}
prob_up_to_125 <- 1 - pbinom(124, size = 200, prob = 0.6)
print(prob_up_to_125)
```

```{r}
found <- FALSE
for (i in seq_len(300)){
  
  if (found == FALSE){
    prob_up_to_125 <- 1 - pbinom(124, size = i, prob = 0.6)
    
    if (prob_up_to_125 >= 0.95){
      print(paste("We would need to run at least", i, "trials to get 125 flowers with 95% probability.")) 
      found <- TRUE
    }
  }
}
```
